draft.body: [P1] Empty input now raises IndexError. Preserve the documented None result for first_name([]).

[P0] `role == "admin" or "editor"` parses as `(role == "admin") or "editor"`, and the non-empty string "editor" is always truthy. can_edit now grants edit permission to every role and returns a string rather than a bool, which breaks the documented contract (true only for admin or editor, otherwise false). Restore `role in ("admin", "editor")`.
